question: What is the total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 8 cm? (π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the cylinder = 7 cm

The height of the cylinder = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

The surface area of the right circular cylinder = 2pi r(r+h)

**Calculation:**

⇒ The surface area of the cylinder = 2pi r(r+h)=2times(22)/(7)times 7(7+8) = 44 x 15 = 660 cm²

⇒ **Hence, The Total surface area of the right circular cylinder is 660 cm².**
